sections.heading: 🌍 Макротон
sections.content: The session exhibits bifurcated risk dynamics as European equities edge higher led by the DAX at 26,956 while Asian markets closed broadly lower. The primary catalyst is corporate governance uncertainty emanating from Silicon Valley coupled with persistent fiscal and inflation anxiety pushing the US 10Y to 4.998%.

sections.heading: 🛢 Маслостойкий стол
sections.content:
Crude benchmarks are holding steady with WTI at 86.65 and Brent at 92.92, showing marginal daily gains of 0.14% and 0.17% respectively. Energy markets are range-bound as traders weigh incremental supply adjustments against broader macroeconomic headwinds and flat weekly performance.
Cross-asset read
US Treasury yields are grinding higher with the 10Y up 1.5bp to 4.998% while the DXY holds near 102.89, maintaining downward pressure on precious metals with Gold down 1.62% to 3,935.70. Equities show resilience led by the Nasdaq 100 gaining 2.28% to 28,374 despite steep losses in key individual semiconductor components.
Potential scenarios
▲ Bullish · Nasdaq 100 — above 28,500 opens 29,600 · invalid below 27,900
Tech sector dip buyers stepping in to absorb Nvidia headline volatility.
▼ Bearish · Gold — below 3,900.00 opens 3,750.00 · invalid above 4,020.00

Key risks
• Escalating regulatory and political fallout surrounding major semiconductor leadership.
• Unanticipated spikes in US Treasury yields testing key psychological thresholds.
